【subject_definitions】
- woman: a warm young East Asian woman in her mid-20s, shoulder-length dark brown hair, soft natural makeup, wearing a cream knit top; she sits at a tidy desk in a softly lit home-studio, looking directly into the camera; throughout the shot her mouth movements and jaw motion are driven by the reference audio drive_audio, with lip shape and syllable timing matching drive_audio syllable by syllable (口型与驱动音频逐音节同步).
- environment: a cozy content-creator studio — warm beige wall, blurred bookshelf and a small plant in the background, soft key light from the front-left, gentle rim light, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh.
- drive_audio: the sole reference audio; a warm female Chinese voice delivering the full tutorial line; it drives all spoken sound and all lip/jaw motion in this video.

【summary】
One continuous 15-second talking-head video. A young woman sits in a warm, softly lit studio facing the camera and delivers a Chinese pitch about how to build a digital human using one photo, one audio clip, and the MiniMax H3 workflow. Her mouth and jaw are fully driven by the reference audio drive_audio and stay in strict syllable-by-syllable sync with drive_audio for the entire shot (口型与驱动音频逐音节同步). No other sound sources, no background music.

【retention_analysis】
- From drive_audio: retain the complete Chinese utterance verbatim, including its natural pacing, intonation, and the warm female timbre; retain its exact 15-second timing envelope so every syllable aligns with the mouth.
- From text: generate all visual content (subject, set, lighting, camera motion, facial expression, hand gesture) — no other references are provided, so nothing else needs to be retained.
- Lip/jaw motion is not generated freely; it is reproduced from drive_audio at syllable level in every speaking moment.

【detailed_description】
Shot 1 (0s–15s), continuous take, eye-level medium shot slowly pushing into a medium close-up. The woman is centered, framed from the waist up, looking directly into the lens with a friendly, confident expression. The background stays softly blurred. Her speech is the Chinese line from drive_audio, delivered exactly as in drive_audio, with her lip shape, jaw drop, and syllable timing matching drive_audio syllable by syllable (口型与驱动音频逐音节同步) at every point.

- 0.0s–2.5s, "想知道我这种数字人怎么做的？": she tilts her head slightly and raises one eyebrow; jaw opens on "想", lips round and glide on "知道", mouth opens wide on "数字人", ending with a small open-mouth, questioning rise on "做的".
- 2.5s–8.5s, "只需要一张照片、一段音频，加上 MiniMax H3 工作流，就能复刻同款。": steady tutorial rhythm; jaw drops clearly on "照片" and "音频", lips form the English syllables of "MiniMax H3" with visible mouth shape, a small nod on "加上", and a brief confident smile as "同款" closes; hands rest on the desk, one palm lifting subtly on "工作流".
- 8.5s–15.0s, "别光看，现在跟我操作一遍，你也能做出自己的虚拟人。": she leans slightly forward toward the camera; jaw opens on "别", lips press on "光", mouth shapes each word of the final call-to-action in sync with drive_audio, ending on "虚拟人" with a soft closed-lip smile as the camera completes its push-in; head settles, expression warm and assured.

Camera: very slow linear dolly-in over the full 15 seconds; no cuts, no rotation, focal length around 50mm. Sound: only the Chinese voice of drive_audio, close-mic'd and clean, with faint warm room ambience.

【overall_soundscape】
A warm female Chinese voice from drive_audio is the sole foreground sound, close and dry with subtle room tone, no reverb, no SFX, no secondary speakers. The audio track follows the 15-second timing of drive_audio exactly; every syllable of the voice coincides with the corresponding mouth opening and jaw motion on screen.

【non_diegetic_music】
None — no background music, no sound effects, no added audio beyond the drive_audio voice.
